0022600208.text: The Rockets (7-3, 2nd in the Southwest and 7th in the West) host the Nuggets (5-3, 4th in the Northwest and 9th in the West) in Houston's 11th game of the season, with Houston on a two-game losing streak and Denver riding a two-game winning streak. Houston is 4-1 at home, but Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) are both out, while Denver, 3-1 on the road, is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain). This is the first meeting between the teams this season, and in 2025-26 Houston lost the series 1-3, including a 129-93 loss in Denver on March 11, 2026.
